instructions: Review PRs against FloCafe core architectural invariants and guidelines documented in AGENTS.md and docs/reference/product-invariants.md. Pay particular attention to offline-first invariants, ensuring orders are never ownership-gated by user_id, respecting configurable permissions without hardcoding roles, preserving customer data across migrations, and honoring the static export boundary for desktop frontend.
